# oriz Chat — full content

> Free, streaming AI chat that runs entirely in your browser. 100% client-side — no upload, no signup, no API key. Live at https://chat.oriz.in

## What it is

oriz Chat is a free AI chat app that runs entirely in your web browser. It supports multi-turn conversations, a full model picker with automatic multi-provider failover, sanitized markdown rendering, on-device conversation history, prompt presets, and export to Markdown or JSON. There is no backend, no account, and no API key — the only network calls are the AI completion requests you initiate, routed through g4f providers.

## Hero

Talk to the aurora. Free, streaming AI chat — right in your browser. Pick any model, choose a preset, and keep the whole conversation on your own device.

## Features

### Any model, auto failover
Full g4f model picker with multi-provider failover — no API key, no signup. If one provider is down, the request automatically retries against another.

### Markdown + code
Responses render as sanitized markdown with fenced code blocks, tables and lists. Markdown parsing (marked) and sanitization (DOMPurify) are lazy-loaded.

### Private history
Conversations save to IndexedDB on your device. Nothing leaves the browser. Browse, reopen, and delete past conversations.

### Presets + export
Jump-start with system-prompt presets. Export any chat as Markdown or JSON.

### Streaming chat
Token-by-token responses via @chirag127/oz-ai (g4f multi-provider client, no API key).

### Drag & drop
Drop a .txt or .md file into the composer to load it as context.

### Accessible + responsive
WCAG-AA contrast, keyboard navigation, works from mobile (390px) to desktop (1440px).

## Prompt presets

- General assistant — a helpful, concise assistant that uses markdown when useful.
- Code helper — an expert software engineer giving correct, minimal code with short explanations and fenced code blocks with language tags.
- Brainstorm — a creative brainstorming partner offering diverse, concrete ideas as short bulleted lists.
- Explain simply — explains concepts clearly for a curious beginner using analogies and short paragraphs.
- Rewrite / polish — improves writing, keeps the author's voice, fixes grammar, tightens prose, returns only the rewritten text.
- Translate — a professional translator that detects the source language and translates faithfully, preserving tone and formatting.

## How to use

1. Open https://chat.oriz.in in any modern browser.
2. Pick a model from the model picker (any g4f model; failover is automatic).
3. Optionally choose a prompt preset to set the system prompt.
4. Type your message and send — responses stream token-by-token.
5. Continue the multi-turn conversation; it saves automatically to IndexedDB on your device.
6. Browse, reopen, or delete past conversations from your private history.
7. Export any conversation as Markdown or JSON at any time.

## Privacy

100% client-side. No backend, no accounts, no telemetry. Conversations save to IndexedDB on your own device and never touch a server. The only network calls are the AI completion requests you initiate, routed through g4f providers. History and exports stay on your device.

## Tech

- Astro (static output), client-only React 19 islands, Tailwind CSS v4.
- AI via @chirag127/oz-ai — a g4f multi-provider browser client, keyless.
- Markdown via marked + DOMPurify (lazy-loaded).
- History via idb (IndexedDB).
- Installable PWA (offline shell + runtime caching).
- Shared atomic @chirag127/* packages (oz-ai, oz-file, oz-tokens-base, oz-chrome) for mechanism only; the visual theme is bespoke to this site.

## FAQ

Is it free? Yes, completely free. No signup, no API key, no card.

Do you store my chats? No. Conversations live only in your browser's IndexedDB. Nothing is uploaded.

Do I need an account? No. There is no auth on this free tool.

Which models can I use? Every model exposed by g4f, with automatic failover between providers.

Can I use it offline? The app shell is a PWA and installs/caches offline, but AI completions need a network connection to reach a provider.
